notes:
Background:
- Small YC-ish shop building a JetBrains plugin (IntelliJ/PyCharm) that does code completion and refactor suggestions using local index + cloud LLM. 60 devs internal, target customer base are enterprise engineering teams.

Technical requirements (high level):
- Local indexing on developer workstation (privacy-first): index stored on dev machine, never sent to cloud unless user opts in.
- Low-latency streaming token-by-token during typing, target perceived latency < 50ms for completion suggestions in IDE.
- Model/version pinning: need to pin to a stable revision for GA (they mentioned "1.2.3-stable") and be able to fallback to quantized local model (8-bit) when offline.
- Routing & fallbacks: prefer hosted for feature parity but require Dedicated/Private options for enterprise customers to meet data residency and IP controls.
- Offline mode: small quantized model that runs locally for basic completions and safety/timeouts.

Security/compliance:
- Must support SSO/SAML for enterprise installs, detailed audit logging for developer actions, KMS integration for keys, SOC2 required for hosted offering. EU customers will require data residency controls.

Business/POC goals:
- Validate streaming latency on common dev machines (macbook m1/2, linux x86) with their plugin and sample repo.
- Compare token cost & throughput between Redwood hosted and a Dedicated pool with prefix caching.
- Confirm legal/licensing for distributing quantized local model to end users.

Customer quotes / call highlights:
- CTO (A. Velasquez): "Latency has to feel instant — if completion lags, adoption dies."
- Lead engineer: "We need model pinning; our customers require deterministic behavior across releases."

POC scope agreed:
- Redwood to provide temporary Dedicated credentials + a quantized model artifact OR guidance to serve a compatible local model.
- NeedleBeam to provide a small mono-repo (10k LOC) and JetBrains plugin branch to test integration and streaming behavior.
- Security team to run Redwood security FAQ and SOC2 evidence.

Notes/concise next steps (shorthand):
- 03/12: SE deep-dive — Ethan ran perf checklist, requested dev VM specs.
- 03/14: Redwood to upload quantized model sample to secured drive (action: Priya).
- 03/18: POC kickoff (schedule tentative) — NeedleBeam to share test repo + list of target IDE versions.

Potential upsell / long term:
- Dedicated pools for enterprise customers with on-prem control plane + per-route cost optimization via Redwood Optimize.

Risk flags:
- Licensing for distributing quantized weights may require legal review.
- JetBrains marketplace plugin policies may constrain automatic model downloads to user-initiated flows.
